name: Non Deliverable Trade
definition: Foreign exchange contract where one of the exchanged amounts is specified in a non-deliverable currency.

SettlementCurrency.name: Settlement Currency
SettlementCurrency.definition: Currency in which a non-deliverable contract is settled.

FixingConditions.name: Fixing Conditions
FixingConditions.definition: Set of parameters used to calculate a rate for instance the fixing rate to be applied to a non-deliverable agreement.

OpeningLeg.name: Opening Leg
OpeningLeg.definition: Specifies the opening leg of a non deliverable trade in which the forward rate and amount are specified together with the fixing conditions.

ClosingLeg.name: Closing Leg
ClosingLeg.definition: Specifies the closing leg of a non deliverable trade in which the amount to be settled is the difference in the deliverable currency betweem its original value and the countervalue calculated against the fixing rate.
